description: Component for predicting customer churn risk using heuristic scoring.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame with customer activity data. Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Also required (with execution_mode='sql') to name the FROM-source for the server-side training/prediction query. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

scoring_method.label: Scoring Method
scoring_method.description: 'heuristic' (default): the original weighted activity-decline scoring, unchanged. 'ml': fits a real scikit-learn classifier against a target_column you supply -- the heuristic has no access to any historical 'did this customer churn' label, so 'ml' mode requires you bring one, plus target_column + feature_columns.

execution_mode.label: Execution Mode
execution_mode.description: Only meaningful when scoring_method='ml'. 'python' (default): fits a real scikit-learn LogisticRegression locally. 'sql': trains AND predicts server-side via BigQuery/Snowflake ML (Databricks is predict-only). Requires source, sql_dialect, output_table, and model_name.

output_table.label: Output Table
output_table.description: Required when execution_mode='sql'. Destination table the predictions are written to.

model_name.label: Model Name
model_name.description: Required when execution_mode='sql'. For snowflake/bigquery: the identifier this component creates the model under. For databricks: the name of an already-served Model Serving endpoint -- this dialect trains nothing.

target_column.label: Target Column
target_column.description: Required when scoring_method='ml'. Column name of the historical churn label (e.g. a boolean 'churned' column) -- this does NOT exist in the heuristic's input schema; you must supply it.

feature_columns.label: Feature Columns
feature_columns.description: Required when scoring_method='ml'. List of column names to use as classifier features.

test_size.label: Test Size
test_size.description: scoring_method='ml' only. Fraction of data to hold out for evaluation

random_state.label: Random State
random_state.description: scoring_method='ml' only. Random seed for reproducibility

max_iter.label: Max Iter
max_iter.description: scoring_method='ml' only. Maximum number of solver iterations

model_path.label: Model Path
model_path.description: scoring_method='ml' only. If set, joblib-dump the trained model to this path after fit. Supports local paths and any fsspec URL (s3://, gs://, abfs://).

output_probabilities.label: Output Probabilities
output_probabilities.description: scoring_method='ml' only. Add predicted_proba_<class> columns per class

normalize.label: Normalize
normalize.description: scoring_method='ml' only. Standardize features with StandardScaler before fitting

inactivity_threshold_days.label: Inactivity Threshold Days
inactivity_threshold_days.description: scoring_method='heuristic' only. Days of inactivity to consider high risk

lookback_days.label: Lookback Days
lookback_days.description: scoring_method='heuristic' only. Days to look back for historical comparison. NOTE: accepted but not currently used by the heuristic scoring math (pre-existing, documented not fixed).

include_risk_factors.label: Include Risk Factors
include_risk_factors.description: scoring_method='heuristic' only. Include detailed risk factors in output

customer_id_field.label: Customer Id Field
customer_id_field.description: Customer ID column name (auto-detected if not specified)

last_activity_field.label: Last Activity Field
last_activity_field.description: Last activity date column (auto-detected if not specified)

total_orders_field.label: Total Orders Field
total_orders_field.description: Total orders column (auto-detected if not specified)

total_revenue_field.label: Total Revenue Field
total_revenue_field.description: Total revenue column (auto-detected if not specified)

lifetime_days_field.label: Lifetime Days Field
lifetime_days_field.description: Customer lifetime days column (auto-detected if not specified)

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.

partition_start.label: Partition Start Date
partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.

partition_date_column.label: Partition Date Column
partition_date_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current date partition key (e.g. 'event_date', 'created_at').

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.

partition_static_dim.label: Static Dimension Name
partition_static_dim.description: Name for the static partition dimension in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'. Defaults to 'segment'.

partition_static_column.label: Static Partition Column
partition_static_column.description: Column used to filter rows to the current static partition value (e.g. 'customer_id', 'region').

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream input columns it derives from, e.g. {"revenue": ["price", "quantity"]}.

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: How many rows to include in the preview. Large tables (>10× this number) are sampled randomly.

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Churn Prediction
